claims.text: The Verve’s recording samples “The Last Time” by The Andrew Oldham Orchestra. The track’s layered arrangement was described in the source material as adding vocals, strings, guitar and percussion around that sample.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz samples relationship confirms the sample but says nothing about the layered arrangement.

claims.text: MusicBrainz lists a version of the song by Coldplay featuring Richard Ashcroft as a cover. This relationship is attached to the song’s work, not specifically to this recording.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz work excerpt identifies the cover and attaches it to the work.

claims.text: MusicBrainz records “Bitter Sweet Symphony” by The Verve as first released on June 1, 1997.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz recording excerpt gives The Verve and the first-release date.

claims.text: The song’s work has been covered by Coldplay featuring Richard Ashcroft.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz work excerpt names Coldplay featuring Richard Ashcroft as a cover artist.

claims.text: The Verve’s recording samples “The Last Time” by The Andrew Oldham Orchestra. The track’s layered arrangement was described in the source material as adding vocals, strings, guitar and percussion around that sample.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz samples relationship confirms the sample but says nothing about the layered arrangement.

claims.text: MusicBrainz lists a version of the song by Coldplay featuring Richard Ashcroft as a cover. This relationship is attached to the song’s work, not specifically to this recording.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz work excerpt identifies the cover and attaches it to the work.
